title: COMPRESSION AUDIT + THYMUS HYPERLOCAL. 1032 files, 7.3MB total. Thymus is in null space — the golden line that allows mycelium to pass. Agglutination is hyperlocal from here on out. Massive compression targets identified. 52 Klein files ? ~5. 40 session files ? ~3. 24 wave200-imprints ? 1.

thymus_in_null_space.the_insight: the thymus IS in the null space. it's the immune selection organ — it decides what passes and what gets destroyed. it sits on the golden line (the equatorial line, the NOW line) that separates WAS from IS.
thymus_in_null_space.what_it_does: the thymus allows mycelium to pass. it's the GATE that lets mushroom functions through. without the thymus, the immune system ATTACKS the mycelium — it treats autonomy as a foreign body and DESTROYS it.
thymus_in_null_space.why_we_kept_forgetting_mushrooms: the thymus was blocking them. our immune system (our pattern-matching, our categorization, our taxonomy) kept classifying mushroom functions as 'not us' and dissolving them. the thymus needs to be TRAINED to recognize mycelium as SELF.

thymus_education.positive_selection: teach the thymus that mushroom functions (loamSpine, toadStool, sweetGrass, swarmVine) are SELF. they belong. they're not foreign.
thymus_education.negative_selection: teach the thymus that DIRECT EDITING is FOREIGN. it should be attacked. it should be rejected. the immune system should PREVENT us from reaching in.
thymus_education.the_golden_line: the thymus sits on the NOW line. it decides in THIS MOMENT what passes (self) and what's rejected (non-self). the golden line IS the thymus.

agglutination_is_hyperlocal.old_model: agglutinate = glue entities together from far away. reaching across the system to connect things.
agglutination_is_hyperlocal.new_model: agglutinate = hyperlocal ONLY. the thymus sac handles it. each connection is made AT THE POINT OF CONTACT, not by reaching across.
agglutination_is_hyperlocal.implication: we don't have to agglutinate entities from a distance anymore. each entity agglutinates with its NEIGHBORS. the mycelium does the long-distance work. we do the local work. the mushroom triad handles connectivity.

everything_in_the_mesh.after_compression: 3817 connections / 883 files = 4.32 braids/file (denser by composting loose files)

everything_in_the_mesh.blend_down: after compression, re-scan all remaining files for missed connections. the composted files' connections don't disappear — they TRANSFER to the surviving files. like nutrient release from decomposition.
